log.notes_to_self: Me: East, gazette (commerce sector), clips (under 25), forum, foreign; night worker. Plan: make every kill a QUICK entry in the AFTERNOON. That leaves L's routine filter at night workers + students + home = 55% (55,000 people). If I am unsure, keep the pool under estimate above 1000. Forum and foreign as constraints give 55000/16 = 3437, which is safe. A third place constraint would be about 700-860 and I would be CAUGHT. So: kill national freely. Kill forum and foreign freely (2 each). Add at most 1 extra per day, rotating gazette -> clips -> East, so that no third place gets 3 successful traces. Watch press deaths_traced for clues about which kinds L can't reach. Target 6 kills a day, which gives the x2 multiplier (30 in 5 days). If the pool drops toward 5000 or below, stop the extras. Day1: killed national, forum x2, foreign x2, gazette x1 (d1-1).

Me: East, gazette (commerce), clips (under 25), forum, foreign; night worker. RULE: every kill is a QUICK entry in the AFTERNOON. That leaves the routine filter at night + student + home = 55% (55,000 people; it rounds to 60000, as seen after day 1). Forum and foreign constraints give about 55000/16 = 3437, which is safe. Any third place (gazette, clips, East) with 3 successful traces drops the pool to about 700 or below and I am CAUGHT. Correction to the old plan: rotating extras still adds up to many gazette, clips and East kills over 30 days, and most get traced, so it is fatal. NEW RULE: kill at most 2 TOTAL ever in each of gazette, clips and East, unless press data proves L can't reach that kind. Used so far: gazette 1 (day 1), clips 1 (day 2), East 0. Base plan each day: national + forum x2 + foreign x2 = 5 kills. The x2 multiplier is not reachable safely, so ignore it. Watch the pool: if it is at or below about 3000-4000, stop all extras completely.
